Below, add four bulleted lines in bold black ~20pt with small round bullets, in this exact order and casing: 'Rotation Invariant', 'Scaling Invariant', 'Translation invariant', 'Mirroring Invariant'; even vertical spacing. 7. Draw a solid black rectangle across the bottom (approx. left 4%, top 96%, width 92%, height 4%) as a footer bar. 8. Leave the area between the content box and footer bar empty. 9.
